phase: Phase 5: The rest of the inventory (after the look check)
summary: All seven characters meet the 7.5 character bar. No confirmed critical fault was seen in 32 inspected PNGs: seven static renders with references, point-up for all six gesture-bearing characters, stretch-up and hug-self for Lily and Mom, and three to eight gestures per adult. F1 is closed: point-up sleeves no longer expose skin and Mom's sweater hem no longer points. F2 is closed: Lily's fringe reads as separate soft locks and the dark face rim is reduced. F3 is closed: both base SHAs were supplied and verified. One small brown patch on Grandpa's sweater in listen is recorded as a nonblocking item for confirmation.
nonblocking_findings: Grandpa: a small brown oval appears on the side of the green sweater in gestures-adult/grandpa/listen.png. It is not visible in point-up, stretch-up, hug-self, reach, eat-lift, count-fingers-high or turn-side. Confirm whether it is trouser fabric or skin through the sweater, and remove it either way.

The requested clap frames do not exist for Lily or Mom in week2-7; only week1 adventurer has clap-apart and clap-together. hug-self and stretch-up were inspected as substitutes. No fault was seen in them.
The named style differences from the references are recorded per character below. None reaches the critical-fault bar.
evidence: HEAD at start was 78dbd2284571a05f2bf63f9212940f1a01ad748c, matching the supplied audited_head and role_base_sha. HEAD is current; no commit after 554b61c4 touches the sprout assets or this track.
phase_base_sha e43ccce0 is the commit that renamed the heading to '## Phase 5: The rest of the inventory (after the look check)' in plan.md. F3 is closed.
Fix commits confirmed: ef5be6c4 (adult sleeves cover the arm), 4fa91ee8 (Grandma cuffs close on the wrist), 4f7a6776 (Lily fringe locks r5). All fall inside the phase range e43ccce0..HEAD.
Read plan.md lines 280-339 and spec.md. The spec requires an independent review at the 7.5 character bar and a G rating with no combat, injury or weapon.
Inspected seven static renders, each with its reference: out/sprout-{lily,adult-base,mom,dad,grandma,grandpa,tom}/render.png.

Inspected point-up.png for Lily, Tom, Mom, Dad, Grandma and Grandpa. Every raised arm is covered to the wrist; the hand emerges at the cuff with no jagged skin patches. Mom's sweater hem is flat with no sharp point. F1 is closed.

Inspected stretch-up.png and hug-self.png for Lily, Mom, Dad, Grandma and Grandpa; listen.png for Lily, Dad, Grandma and Grandpa; plus Grandpa reach, eat-lift, count-fingers-high and turn-side. No hand or skin passes through a garment or hair in these frames.
Lily's fringe now shows five separate soft bangs with different depths in front, three-quarter and gesture views. The dark inner face rim is reduced. F2 is closed.

No character wears a hat, helmet or head covering in this cast, and no accessory faces the wrong way. Grandpa's glasses and mustache face front; the white shape at the back of his head is a hair band, not a reversed mustache. All characters are clothed, friendly and rated G.
No builds or renders were run. Only existing PNG files were inspected with the read tool. PROJECT_DEV_URL was not used because this review is image-only by task instruction.
